items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser to clean oily skin without stripping it while you are pregnant.
A gentle leave-on option often used during pregnancy to help skin look clearer and calmer, though please run it by your prenatal provider first.
A light ceramide moisturizer to support the look of a comfortable, balanced skin barrier, since your moisture score is on the lower side.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily sun protection that suits pregnancy-friendly routines.

response.routine_note: We have left out the benzoyl peroxide washes because we would like you to check with your prenatal provider or a dermatologist before using any acne-focused active while pregnant, and breakouts you describe as severe are best reviewed by one. Meanwhile, cleanse morning and night, apply azelaic acid at night, then moisturize, and use SPF every morning.
